title: Run-Loop Webhook Integration — Push-Based Pipeline Status
description: Currently the Pipeline Monitor polls for status. run-loop.sh should POST events to Rorcha's API as stories pass/fail, giving real-time push updates without polling. This makes the Pipeline Monitor accurate to the second and enables Rorcha to auto-update story results, elapsed times, and final run status without the user having to manually trigger a pipeline run record.

userStories.title: Backend: webhook receiver endpoints for run-loop events
userStories.description:
Add webhook endpoints that run-loop.sh can POST to as pipeline events occur. These are fire-and-forget from the script's perspective — if the POST fails, the loop continues unaffected.

File: ~/rorcha/backend/src/routes/pipeline.ts (extend existing file)

New endpoints:

POST /api/pipeline/webhook/run-start
- Body: { workspaceId, specPath, pid, specTitle }
- Creates a pipeline_runs record with status='running'
- Broadcasts SSE: broadcast('all', 'run_started', { runId, specTitle })
- Returns { runId } — the script stores this for subsequent webhook calls

POST /api/pipeline/webhook/story-result
- Body: { runId, storyId, storyTitle, status: 'pass'|'fail'|'skip', durationMs, retries, logPath }
- Upserts into story_results table
- Broadcasts SSE: broadcast('all', 'story_result', { runId, storyId, status })
- Emits WAL event: event_type='story_' + status
- Returns { ok: true }

POST /api/pipeline/webhook/run-finish
- Body: { runId, status: 'done'|'failed', totalMs, passCount, failCount, skipCount }
- Updates pipeline_runs.status and finished_at
- Broadcasts SSE: broadcast('all', 'run_finished', { runId, status })
- Returns { ok: true }

All endpoints: no auth required (local-only, bound to 127.0.0.1). Validate runId exists before story-result/run-finish.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/pipeline/webhook/run-start creates pipeline_runs record, returns { runId }
POST /api/pipeline/webhook/story-result upserts story_results, broadcasts SSE
POST /api/pipeline/webhook/run-finish updates run status and finished_at
All 3 endpoints emit corresponding WAL events
All 3 endpoints broadcast to SSE hub so Pipeline Monitor updates in real time
Invalid runId on story-result/run-finish returns 404
cd ~/rorcha/backend && npx tsc --noEmit passes

userStories.title: run-loop.sh: add RORCHA_API_URL webhook calls at key lifecycle points
userStories.description:
Extend ~/rorcha/scripts/run-loop.sh to POST webhook events if RORCHA_API_URL is set. When not set, the loop behaves exactly as before (no-op, fully backward compatible).

Add near the top of run-loop.sh:
```bash
# Rorcha webhook integration (optional)
RORCHA_API="${RORCHA_API_URL:-}"
RUN_ID=""  # populated after run-start webhook

rorcha_webhook() {
  local path="$1" data="$2"
  [ -z "$RORCHA_API" ] && return 0  # no-op if not configured
  curl -s -X POST "${RORCHA_API}${path}" \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d "$data" --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 || true
}
```

Call points:
1. **Before first story runs**: `rorcha_webhook /api/pipeline/webhook/run-start "{\"workspaceId\":\"$WORKSPACE_ID\",\"specPath\":\"$JSON_FILE\",\"pid\":$$}"` — capture returned runId
2. **After each story passes/fails**: `rorcha_webhook /api/pipeline/webhook/story-result ...`
3. **After loop finishes**: `rorcha_webhook /api/pipeline/webhook/run-finish ...`

Add `--workspace` arg to run-loop.sh to pass workspaceId:
```bash
--workspace) WORKSPACE_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
```

Without --workspace, WORKSPACE_ID defaults to basename of the spec file path (best-effort).
acceptanceCriteria: run-loop.sh has rorcha_webhook() function that no-ops when RORCHA_API_URL unset
run-start webhook called before first story, runId captured from response
story-result webhook called after each story with correct status and duration
run-finish webhook called after loop completes with final counts
--workspace flag accepted, defaults to spec basename if omitted
Loop continues normally if any webhook POST fails (--max-time 5, || true)
Existing behavior unchanged when RORCHA_API_URL not set

userStories.title: Pipeline Monitor: live story progress from SSE without polling
userStories.description:
Update PipelineMonitorPanel.tsx to drive story status entirely from SSE events rather than fetching on interval. The existing usePipelineSSE hook already connects to EventSource — extend it to handle the new event types.

File: ~/rorcha/src/hooks/usePipelineSSE.ts

Handle new event types:
- `run_started` → add run to the run list in local state, auto-select it
- `story_result` → update story status in current run's story array
- `run_finished` → update run status, set finished_at

In PipelineMonitorPanel.tsx:
- Remove any setInterval polling
- Derive story list from SSE event stream (build up state from events)
- Elapsed time: use a local 1-second `setInterval` just for the elapsed counter display (not for data fetching)
- Run list still fetched once on mount (for historical runs); SSE handles live updates only

Story row state machine from events:
```
pending → running (story_started) → pass|fail|skip (story_result)
```

Progress bar: `(passCount + failCount + skipCount) / totalStories * 100`
acceptanceCriteria: usePipelineSSE handles run_started, story_result, run_finished event types
New run appears in sidebar automatically when run_started SSE event arrives
Story rows update in real time as story_result events arrive — no polling
Run status updates to done/failed when run_finished event arrives
Progress bar reflects live story completion count
Elapsed time counter updates every second via local interval (display only)
Historical runs still fetched on mount via GET /api/pipeline/runs
npx tsc --noEmit passes

userStories.title: One-click 'Start Run' from Pipeline Monitor with workspace + spec selection
userStories.description:
Currently 'Start New Run' is a stub that shows a terminal command. Replace it with a real launch dialog that generates the exact command pre-filled with webhook config.

In PipelineMonitorPanel.tsx, clicking 'Start New Run' opens an inline panel:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Start Pipeline Run                                  │
│                                                      │
│  Workspace:  [Rorcha ▼]                              │
│  Spec:       [direction-stack-l2... ▼]  (approved)   │
│                                                      │
│  Run command (copy & paste into terminal):           │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ RORCHA_API_URL=http://localhost:3030 \         │  │
│  │   ~/rorcha/scripts/run-loop.sh \               │  │
│  │   --json /path/to/spec.json \                  │  │
│  │   --workspace rorcha                           │  │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│  [Copy Command]                                      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Workspace dropdown: populated from GET /api/workspaces
Spec dropdown: populated from GET /api/specs?workspaceId=&status=approved
'Copy Command': copies the full command to clipboard, shows '✓ Copied' for 2s

This replaces the stub — no actual process spawning from the UI (security boundary).

Workspace dropdown populated from GET /api/workspaces

Generated command includes RORCHA_API_URL, --json path, and --workspace flag

userStories.title: Gate validation — webhook round-trip and Pipeline Monitor live update
userStories.description:
Full gate for the webhook integration feature.

**Checklist (document in story notes):**
1. `cd ~/rorcha/backend && npm test` — all tests pass including new webhook endpoint tests
2. `npx tsc --noEmit` at ~/rorcha/ root — 0 errors
3. Start Rorcha: `cd ~/rorcha && npm run dev`
4. Navigate to Pipeline Monitor — run list shows historical runs (if any)
5. In a separate terminal, manually POST to /api/pipeline/webhook/run-start → verify run appears in sidebar
6. POST /api/pipeline/webhook/story-result → verify story row updates without refresh
7. POST /api/pipeline/webhook/run-finish → verify run status updates to done
8. Run a real spec via the generated command from 'Start New Run' with RORCHA_API_URL set → watch Pipeline Monitor update live
9. `npm run build` — clean build
10. `git add -A && git commit -m 'feat(webhooks): run-loop webhook integration + live Pipeline Monitor'`
acceptanceCriteria: Backend webhook tests pass (POST run-start, story-result, run-finish)
npx tsc --noEmit passes at ~/rorcha/ root
Pipeline Monitor updates in real time from SSE without polling
Start New Run panel generates correct command with RORCHA_API_URL
Full round-trip tested: run-loop.sh with RORCHA_API_URL set → Pipeline Monitor updates live
npm run build passes cleanly
